tools.name: media_whats_on
tools.description: What is airing right now, or at a given time. Returns programmes with descriptions and, for each, when the claim was observed and when it expires. Accepts free text.

query.description: Free text: a title, genre, or channel name. Optional.

outlet.description: Restrict to one channel by name.

tools.name: media_receivable
tools.description: Which television transmitters reach a specific latitude and longitude, graded by real terrain between the tower and that point. Answers "what can I actually watch from here", which listings services cannot.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "42.4086,-73.3054" or a note about the location.

antenna_ft.description: Receiving antenna height in feet above ground. Default 30.

terrain.description: Compute terrain grades. Default true. First call for a location takes ~15s; cached after.

tools.name: media_still_true
tools.description: Is a remembered claim about a programme still current? Returns when it was observed, whether it has expired, and what replaced it. This is the question a model cannot answer about its own training data.

query.description: The programme or claim to check.

tools.name: media_outlets
tools.description: Search stations, networks and streaming channels by name, callsign, network or owner. Returns licence status, transmitter power and antenna height where filed.

tools.name: media_closed
tools.description: Channels that have shut down, with the date they closed. Useful for checking whether a channel a model remembers still exists.

tools.name: media_verify
tools.description: Verify a signed record from this service. Pass an airing_id, or pass back a record you cached earlier with its signature and we will confirm it is byte-identical to what we signed. The public key and exact canonicalisation are at /.well-known/dtv-intel-signing.json so you can also verify offline without calling us.

query.description: Free text; an airing id is picked out of it if present.

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature that came with the record.

tools.name: media_station_readiness
tools.description: Whether a US television station website can be read by an AI assistant: which AI crawlers it blocks by name in robots.txt, whether it publishes llms.txt or /.well-known/ai, and whether it has structured data. Pass a callsign for one station, or nothing for the industry-wide summary broken down by owner group.

query.description: A callsign such as WNYT, or free text. Omit for the summary.

tools.name: media_freshness
tools.description: How current this dataset is: when each source last ran, how many assertions are live versus expired, and the gaps we know we have.

tools.name: media_sources
tools.description: Where the data comes from, each with its licence and whether it may be redistributed.
